newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values up on weather.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values up on weather.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were higher Wednesday and wheat offers were unchanged, U.S. exporters said.
Soybean were up in response to wintry weather in the U.S. Midwest, cash sources said.

Traders continued to watch the condition of the Mississippi river. Ice is beginning to slow barge traffic considerably, and another blast of Arctic air on Friday is expected to worsen the situation, traders said.
In export news, Algeria on Wednesday bought an additional 50,000 tonnes of French wheat.
Algeria also bought 75,000 tonnes of French wheat on Tuesday, traders said.
